text: This therapy is a lot like the way I [re-do trauma memories](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/189761959/re-do-trauma-memories) in my inner child reparenting guide. Instead of EMDR's mechanical approach, the Imagery Rescripting therapist is there with you as you explain the scene, and they step in as the ideal adult, protecting and nurturing your inner child. Then you learn to do that yourself. Because rescripting takes you back into the memory like EMDR does, the same care goes for it: stop when it's too much, and ground yourself afterward.
reader: an adult reading the somatic guide's memory therapies, deciding whether Imagery Rescripting is for them and how it differs from EMDR
